notConfigured.title: Supabase is not configured
notConfigured.description: To {action}, add the Supabase URL and publishable key to .env.local.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Sign in with your reader account or the editorial account you were invited to.
signIn.cardDescription: The administration area is open only to invited editorial members.
signIn.returnNotice: After signing in, you will return to the page you were on.
signIn.noAccount: Don’t have an account? <link>Create a reader account</link>
signIn.sessionNote: Session data is kept in secure cookies and verified on the server with every request.

notices.inviteNoSession: Open the invitation link again to set a password.
notices.inviteInvalid: The invitation link is invalid or has expired.
notices.confirmFailed: The confirmation link could not be completed in this browser. If the link was valid, your email is confirmed; try signing in.
notices.accountDeleted: Your account and the data linked to it have been deleted.

signUp.title: Create account
signUp.description: You don’t need an account to read posts. With a reader account you can save posts and write comments.
signUp.cardTitle: Sign up with email and password
signUp.cardDescription: You need to confirm your email address before using your account. A reader account does not grant access to the administration area.
signUp.displayNameHint: This name will appear on your comments. You can change it later.

passwordReset.title: Reset password
passwordReset.description: Enter your email address; if an account is registered with it, we will send a reset link.
passwordReset.invalidLink: The reset link is invalid, already used, or expired. Request a new link and open it in the same browser.
passwordReset.cardDescription: The link is valid for one hour and can be used only once.

setPassword.title: Set password
setPassword.description: Your invitation is confirmed. Set a password to continue.
setPassword.storageNote: Your password is stored only by Supabase Auth.

passwordForm.managerHint: We recommend storing this password in a password manager.

inviteConfirm.title: Confirm invitation
inviteConfirm.description: Your invitation link is being verified. Next, you will set your password.
inviteConfirm.cardDescription: This usually takes a few seconds.
inviteConfirm.invalid: The invitation link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new invitation.

passwordPolicy.hint: At least {min} characters, including at least one letter and one digit.
passwordPolicy.tooShort: The password must be at least {min} characters long.
passwordPolicy.tooLong: The password cannot be longer than {max} bytes.
passwordPolicy.lettersDigits: The password must contain at least one letter and one digit.

displayName.tooLong: The display name cannot exceed {max} characters.

rateLimit.limited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
rateLimit.unavailable: This action is not available right now. Try again later.

errors.emailNotConfirmed: Your email address is not confirmed yet. Open the confirmation link in your inbox.
errors.signUpFailed: The account could not be created. Try again later.
errors.missingSession: No session found. Open the link again or sign in again.
errors.samePassword: The new password must differ from the current password.
errors.passwordUpdateFailed: The password could not be updated. Open the link again and retry.

success.signUp: A confirmation link has been sent to your email address. Open it in the same browser to activate your account.
success.passwordResetSent: If an account is registered with this address, a password reset link has been sent. Check your inbox.
